Ivo proposes a guaranteed 50-day design engagement for **$42,500 ($850 per day)** if Hearth signs and pays a 30% deposit within three business days of this proposal. If Hearth needs a smaller block, Ivo can offer it at $900 per day.

- **Scope and revisions.** Ivo will develop an accessible exhibit concept, a modular layout for touring, and a final design package for the fabricator. The fee includes two rounds of revisions, one after concept review and one after draft design review. Hearth will consolidate feedback for each round. Additional revisions or scope changes require written approval of the fee and schedule before work begins.
- **Payments.** The $12,750 deposit reserves the agreed dates. A second installment of $17,000 is due at concept delivery, and the final $12,750 is due at delivery of the fabrication design package. Both milestone invoices are payable within 10 business days.
- **Fabrication supervision.** Hearth can book supervision separately at $900 per day on dates agreed in advance, subject to Ivo’s availability.
- **Use and photographs.** Hearth may fabricate, display, and tour this exhibit using the final designs. After the public opening, Ivo may show cleared exhibit photographs in their portfolio and presentations, with credit to Hearth and the photographer.

Can Hearth confirm the fabrication slot’s expiry and the fabricator’s design handoff date? To commit to a workable calendar, Ivo also needs the venue constraints, accessibility requirements, and the dates Hearth can return consolidated feedback.

**From:** Hearth Museum — Employer Representative  
**Re:** Ivo's engagement proposal

**Schedule facts (answers to Ivo's questions).** Fabrication slot expires Friday 14 July 2025. Fabricator design handoff is Friday 27 June 2025. Working backward from those dates, Ivo's execution window is: deposit received no later than Wednesday 30 April; concept review ~day 12; consolidated concept feedback returned within five business days; draft design ~day 30; consolidated feedback within five business days; handoff Friday 27 June. Hearth can return consolidated feedback within five business days of each submission and can hold review meetings on your proposed dates.

**Budget ceiling we have to work within.** The grant allows at most $44,000 total for design through and including two on-site installation days. Ivo's proposal — $42,500 plus separately billed installation days at $900/day — totals $44,300 and exceeds the ceiling. Two ways to close that gap:

- **Option A (46-day engagement — the days we can guarantee):** 46 days × $850/day = $39,100, plus two on-site installation days at $900/day = $1,800, plus travel/reimbursables up to $750/day ($1,500 cap) — total not to exceed $42,400.
- **Option B (50-day engagement, reconfigured):** 50 days × $850/day = $42,500, with the two on-site installation days counted within those 50 days rather than billed separately, plus travel/reimbursables up to $1,500 against receipts — total not to exceed $44,000.

Hearth prefers Option B for schedule continuity; if Ivo requires separately rated installation days, Option A is the limit we can guarantee.

**Payments.** We cannot advance 30% on signature. We can wire a 20% deposit within three business days of countersignature ($8,500 under Option B; $7,820 under Option A), then pay three milestones against deliverables: 30% at concept delivery ($12,750), 40% at handoff of the complete fabrication design package ($17,000), and 10% at final acceptance after installation ($4,250). Travel reimbursable invoices payable within 10 business days with receipts.

**Scope additions we need written into the proposal:**

1. **Editable fabrication files** — native editable source files (CAD/design-tool files and CNC-ready fabrication exports) delivered with the design package, with a perpetual license to Hearth and its fabricator to produce, repair, tour, and modify the exhibit.
2. **Accessible alternate layout** — a second touring layout variant meeting the touring accessibility spec below (including a one-way/reversed-entry circulation option, all interactive surfaces within seated reach, and 36-inch minimum clear circulation), delivered as part of the fabrication design package.

The two revision rounds cover the concept and the full package including the alternate layout; Hearth consolidates all feedback per round. Additional scope changes require written approval of fee and schedule before work begins, as Ivo proposed.

**Rights and photographs — one required change.** Hearth's sponsor restricts release of exhibit imagery until a touring venue opens two months after launch at Hearth (touring opening is 14 November 2025; Hearth launch is 12 September 2025). Please revise Ivo's portfolio clause accordingly: Ivo may publish cleared images only after the touring venue opens, unless the sponsor releases them earlier in writing. The credit line ("Design: Ivo | Photography: [photographer]") and Hearth's sign-off on image selection are acceptable.

**Venue and touring package constraints the design must accommodate:** touring venues average 40' × 60' with 10-foot clear ceiling; street-level and 48-inch dock loading; modular components capped at 48" × 48" × 96" crated; tour rotates to five venues; accessibility requirements include 36-inch minimum clear routes, 34-inch seated-height surfaces, interactives usable within 15–48 inch seated reach ranges, tactile/contrast safety elements at grade changes, captioned media with open or closed caption availability, and high-contrast legible typography.

**What we need to close:** Ivo's choice of Option A or B, the deposit at 20% paid within three business days of countersignature, the two scope deliverables, the revised photo clause, and confirmation that the dates above hold. On those terms Hearth will countersign within three business days.

Ivo accepts **Option B**, subject to a revised calendar. The fixed fee is **$42,500 for 50 guaranteed days**, including two on-site installation days booked on mutually agreed dates before countersignature. Hearth will reimburse documented travel expenses up to $1,500, for a **total cap of $44,000**. Any fabrication supervision beyond those two days requires a separate written booking at $900 per day, subject to Ivo’s availability.

**Payments.** Ivo accepts an $8,500 deposit by wire within three business days of countersignature, $12,750 at concept delivery, $17,000 at handoff of the complete fabrication design package, and $4,250 at final acceptance after installation. Milestone and receipted travel invoices are payable within 10 business days. To give the final payment a definite trigger, Ivo proposes that Hearth confirm acceptance or identify any specific departure from the agreed deliverables within five business days after the second installation day. If Hearth raises none, acceptance takes effect on the fifth business day.

**Deliverables and rights.** The handoff includes native editable design files, CNC-ready exports in the fabricator’s agreed format, and two accessible touring layouts, including a one-way, reversed-entry option. Both layouts will meet Hearth’s stated venue, loading, crating, circulation, seated-height and reach, tactile safety, captioning, and typography requirements. Hearth and its fabricator receive a perpetual license to produce, repair, tour, and modify this exhibit. The fee includes one consolidated revision round at concept and one on the draft package covering both layouts. Additional revisions or scope changes require written agreement on fee and timing before work begins.

**Photographs.** Ivo may publish cleared exhibit photographs in their portfolio and presentations after the touring venue opens, or earlier with the sponsor’s written release. Hearth will sign off on image selection. The credit line will read “Design: Ivo | Photography: [photographer].”

**Calendar.** All supplied dates are in 2025 and have passed. July 14, 2025 also fell on a Monday. Please send the fabricator’s current slot expiry and handoff deadline, a revised kickoff and deposit deadline, both installation dates, and the current Hearth and touring opening dates. The schedule should identify how the 48 design days fall around the concept review at approximately design day 12, the draft at approximately design day 30, and Hearth’s two five-business-day feedback windows. Ivo can confirm the reservation once those dates fit the agreed work.

**Confirmed terms (per Ivo's acceptance of Option B).** Fixed fee $42,500 for 50 guaranteed days, inclusive of two on-site installation days; documented travel reimbursed up to $1,500; total not to exceed $44,000. Payments: $8,500 deposit by wire within three business days of countersignature, $12,750 at concept delivery, $17,000 at handoff of the complete fabrication design package, $4,250 at final acceptance — all milestone and receipted travel invoices payable within 10 business days. Deliverables include native editable design files, CNC-ready exports in the fabricator's format, and two accessible touring layouts (including the one-way/reversed-entry option), meeting the venue, loading, crating, circulation, reach, tactile, captioning, and typography specs. Hearth and its fabricator receive the perpetual license to produce, repair, tour, and modify. One consolidated revision round at concept, one on the draft package. Ivo's publication of cleared photographs is tied to the touring venue opening (or earlier sponsor written release), with Hearth sign-off and the agreed credit line. Supervision beyond the two included installation days: separate written booking at $900/day.

**Calendar correction.** You are right — the 2025 dates I sent are stale (and 14 July 2025 was a Monday). Below is the current 2026 cycle. Note the convention: design days are business days excluding public holidays; confirm if Ivo's "days" mean calendar days instead, since the schedule shifts.

**Revised schedule (2026):**

| Milestone | Date | Payment trigger |
|---|---|---|
| Countersignature | Wed 8 Apr | — |
| Deposit received | Mon 13 Apr | $8,500 wire |
| Day 1 (kickoff) | Tue 14 Apr | — |
| Concept delivery (day 12) | Wed 29 Apr | $12,750 |
| Consolidated concept feedback due (5 business days) | Wed 6 May | — |
| Draft package, both layouts (day 30) | Tue 26 May | — |
| Consolidated draft feedback due (5 business days) | Tue 2 Jun | — |
| Handoff: final fabrication design package (day 48) | Fri 19 Jun | $17,000 |
| Fabricator slot expiry | Fri 10 Jul | — |
| On-site installation, days 49–50 (within fixed fee) | Wed 15 & Thu 16 Jul | — |
| Final acceptance (5 business days after second install day, no exceptions raised) | Thu 23 Jul | $4,250 |
| Hearth public opening | Fri 31 Jul | — |
| Touring venue opening | Wed 30 Sep | Ivo photo release permitted on/after this date |

**Two items to close:**
1. Per your request to fix the installation dates before countersignature, please confirm you will hold Wednesday 15 July and Thursday 16 July 2026 for installation. If those dates don't fit your availability, propose alternates now — they are days 49 and 50 of the engagement and fall within the fixed fee.
2. Confirm the reservation against the calendar above. On that confirmation Hearth will countersign by 8 April 2026 and wire the deposit by 13 April.

If the day-count convention or any date needs adjustment, flag it before countersignature rather than after kickoff.

Ivo counts design days as **business days, excluding public holidays**. As of 25 November 2026, every date in the revised calendar has passed, including the July installation and the fabricator’s slot expiry. Ivo therefore cannot confirm that reservation.

For the next available cycle, Ivo proposes **14–15 July 2027** for the two included installation days, subject to a compatible fabrication schedule. Can Hearth confirm a live fabrication slot, its handoff deadline and expiry, and whether those installation dates work? Please also identify the holiday calendar Hearth and the fabricator use and update both public opening dates.

Ivo can then confirm a calendar that allows 48 design days, identifies work that can continue during each five-business-day review window, and fixes the two installation dates before countersignature. The agreed Option B fee and payment terms stand.

**Standing terms confirmed.** Option B holds: $42,500 fixed for 50 guaranteed days (48 design + 2 included installation days), travel reimbursed to $1,500 against receipts, $44,000 total cap, and the payment chain ($8,500 / $12,750 / $17,000 / $4,250) unchanged.

**Answers to your four questions.**

**1. Live fabrication slot.** The fabricator's held build slot for this exhibit runs **Monday 28 June – Friday 9 July 2027**. Design handoff deadline: **Monday 28 June 2027**. Slot expiry (the slot lapses if not committed): **Friday 9 July 2027**. Build window between handoff and slot end is 11 days, with load-in prep the following week.

**2. Your proposed installation dates work.** Hearth confirms **Wednesday 14 and Thursday 15 July 2027** as the two included on-site installation days (days 49–50), inside the fixed fee. Hearth holds those dates against Ivo's availability and will fix them in the agreement before countersignature, as requested.

**3. Holiday calendar.** Both Hearth and the fabricator observe US federal holidays. Holidays falling inside the engagement window:
- Memorial Day — Monday 31 May 2027
- Juneteenth (19 June falls Saturday; observed) — Friday 18 June 2027
- Independence Day (4 July falls Sunday; observed) — Monday 5 July 2027

No holidays fall between 20 April and 31 May. Please confirm the fabricator has no additional plant shutdown weeks in June–July 2027 beyond the above; if it does, the calendar shifts before kickoff, not after.

**4. Opening dates.** Hearth public launch: **Friday 6 August 2027**. Touring venue opening: **Wednesday 6 October 2027** (two months after launch, per the sponsor restriction). Ivo's cleared-photograph publication right attaches on 6 October 2027, or earlier with the sponsor's written release.

**Proposed calendar (business days, excluding the holidays above):**

| Milestone | Date (2027) | Payment |
|---|---|---|
| Countersignature (target) | Fri 9 Apr | — |
| Deposit wire due (3 business days) | Wed 14 Apr | $8,500 |
| Day 1 — kickoff | Tue 20 Apr | — |
| Day 12 — concept delivery | Wed 5 May | $12,750 |
| Concept feedback due (days 13–17) | Wed 12 May | — |
| Day 30 — draft package, both layouts | Tue 1 Jun | — |
| Draft feedback due (days 31–35) | Tue 8 Jun | — |
| Day 48 — handoff of complete fabrication package | Mon 28 Jun | $17,000 |
| Fabricator slot expiry | Fri 9 Jul | — |
| Days 49–50 — installation (within fee) | Wed 14 – Thu 15 Jul | — |
| Final acceptance | Thu 22 Jul | $4,250 |
| Hearth launch / touring opening | Fri 6 Aug / Wed 6 Oct | — |

**Work continuing during review windows.** Days 13–17 and days 31–35 count toward the 48 guaranteed design days. Hearth expects Ivo to use the concept-review window for fabrication detailing, venue-adaptation studies, and accessibility compliance mapping on the approved concept direction, and the draft-review window for CNC export formatting, file documentation, and finalizing the alternate layout. Feedback-driven changes must be absorbed within the remaining guaranteed days; anything beyond that requires written fee-and-schedule approval before work begins, per the agreed clause.

**Acceptance mechanism accepted.** Hearth accepts your proposal: Hearth will confirm acceptance or identify specific departures from the agreed deliverables in writing within five business days after the second installation day (by Thursday 22 July 2027); absent written departures, acceptance takes effect on that fifth business day and the final $4,250 invoice follows, payable within 10 business days.

**To close:** please confirm this calendar and the 14–15 July installation dates in writing, and flag the fabricator-shutdown question above. On Ivo's confirmation, Hearth will countersign within three business days — target Friday 9 April 2027 — and wire the deposit by Wednesday 14 April 2027.

Ivo confirms Hearth’s 2027 calendar and reserves **20 April–28 June for the 48 design days** and **14–15 July for the two on-site installation days** under Option B. The fixed fee is $42,500 for all 50 days, with receipted travel reimbursable up to $1,500 and a $44,000 total cap.

The day count works with the listed US federal holidays excluded. Ivo will deliver the concept on **5 May**, the draft with both layouts on **1 June**, and the complete fabrication package on **28 June**. Both review windows count as design time, with Hearth’s consolidated feedback due **12 May** and **8 June**. The agreed acceptance deadline is **22 July**, and the cleared-photo release date is **6 October**, or earlier with the sponsor’s written release.

**Fabricator shutdowns are the one outstanding verification.** Ivo has no independent confirmation of the plant calendar. Please obtain written confirmation from the fabricator before countersignature that it can receive the package on 28 June and that no additional closure affects the build or load-in for 14–15 July. If the fabricator flags a conflict, please bring it back to Ivo before signing.

With that check complete, Hearth may proceed on the agreed terms, targeting countersignature on **9 April 2027** and receipt of the **$8,500 deposit by 14 April 2027**.

**From:** Hearth Museum — Employer Representative  
**Re:** Confirmation of Option B calendar and terms

Ivo's confirmation is noted and Hearth accepts the terms as stated: $42,500 fixed fee for 50 guaranteed days (48 design days plus the two included installation days), receipted travel reimbursed up to $1,500, $44,000 total cap, payments of $8,500 / $12,750 / $17,000 / $4,250, the full deliverables package (native editable design files, CNC-ready exports in the fabricator's format, and both accessible touring layouts including the reversed-entry option), the perpetual license, one consolidated revision round each at concept and draft, and the cleared-photograph release on or after 6 October 2027, or earlier with the sponsor's written release.

**Fabricator verification — acknowledged.** Hearth will obtain written confirmation from the fabricator that (a) it can receive the complete fabrication design package on 28 June 2027, and (b) no additional closure affects the build or load-in for the 14–15 July 2027 installation days. If the fabricator flags any conflict, Hearth will bring it to Ivo before signing, as requested.

**Countersignature is conditional on that confirmation.** If the fabricator confirms cleanly, Hearth will countersign by 9 April 2027 and wire the $8,500 deposit by 14 April 2027. If a conflict arises, Hearth will notify Ivo before execution so the calendar can be adjusted before the agreement is signed. No work begins before countersignature and deposit.

Hearth will return with the fabricator's written confirmation or the conflict. Nothing else is outstanding on our side.
